reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis addresses a completely different alloy system (NbMoTaW-based refractory films under He irradiation) than the research question (CoCrFeNiTi solid-solution deformation), making it scientifically irrelevant to the stated problem.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is detailed but evaluates irradiation resistance in NbMoTaWRe films, not the low hardness/strength and deformation behavior of CoCrFeNiTi, so it cannot test the hypothesis relative to the research question.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is off-topic and provides no insight into the mechanisms governing low hardness and strength in equimolar CoCrFeNiTi, offering zero utility for a researcher working on that question.
